en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a street scene in an old European city. The view looks down a broad street lined with historic stone buildings. On the left is a large church with a rounded apse and Romanesque-Gothic details; beside it rises a tall, narrow bell tower topped with a cross. Further along stands another crenellated tower with a clock. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A caption at the bottom identifies the location as Trento and names the street Via San Vigilio, with a serial number preceding the city name.
